short: A British bomb vessel that explored the Antarctic before being lost in the Franklin expedition.
full:
Constructed in 1826 as a Hecla-class bomb vessel, HMS Erebus possessed a heavily reinforced hull designed to withstand the recoil of heavy mortars. This robust construction made her exceptionally well-suited for polar exploration. Under James Clark Ross, she navigated the Antarctic from 1839 to 1843, discovering the Ross Ice Shelf and Mount Erebus.

In 1845, she was outfitted with auxiliary steam engines and sailed under Sir John Franklin in search of the Northwest Passage. The expedition became trapped in the Canadian Arctic ice. By 1848, the Erebus and her sister ship Terror were abandoned, and the entire crew ultimately perished. Her remarkably intact wreck was finally located in 2014.
